verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway and SDK platform, so a scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no feature for scheduling user-defined recurring jobs or workflows. Budget reset frequency (budget_duration) is an adjacent internal reset setting, and request queueing is not scheduling, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
